pNiche: Practical Recipes & Cooking Guides: Chicken Recipes, Quick and Easy Weeknight Dinners, Essential Cooking Techniques, Air Fryer Recipes, and Meal Prep
pTheme: Next.js App Router frontend with headless WordPress CMS
pStory: CookeTricks helps home cooks get reliable results through practical recipes, clear cooking methods, troubleshooting guidance, and evidence-led testing. Content should solve a specific kitchen problem, explain why the method works, and avoid unsupported claims or generic filler.
pGSC: Build topical authority and organic traffic from Google Search, Google Discover, and Pinterest. Prioritize useful recipe and cooking-guide queries, accurate search intent, original information gain, strong internal linking, and technically sound structured data. Do not invent keyword volumes, rankings, or performance figures.
pSocialStrat: Professional, friendly, practical, and visually useful. Write concise Pinterest titles and descriptions that accurately match the article. Use original food photography and helpful alt text. Avoid clickbait, exaggerated claims, and unsupported time or result promises.

usageRules: Use this channel for topic discovery, technique inspiration, and visual shot planning.
Do not copy titles, descriptions, scripts, article text, ingredient quantities, or instructions verbatim.
Do not download, reuse, republish, or present the creator's video frames, thumbnails, photographs, audio, or footage as CookeTricks assets.
CookeTricks must use original writing and original photography.
Every recipe inspired by this channel must be independently developed and physically tested at least twice.
Record the source URL in internal research notes.
Verify quantities, timings, temperatures, food-safety information, storage guidance, and nutrition independently.
Add real CookeTricks information gain based on testing, including ratios, equipment, dimensions, timing checkpoints, failure cases, and troubleshooting.
Do not imply that Denis Prokopyev endorses, collaborates with, or is affiliated with CookeTricks.
Use authoritative safety sources when safety verification is needed.
Do not use this channel as the sole inspiration source for unrelated categories or as the sole content source for CookeTricks.

qaChecklist: Match one clear search intent and one primary topic without keyword cannibalization
Use one accurate H1 and a concise SEO title and meta description
Lead with the practical result and explain why the method works
Use short paragraphs, plain American English, and 6th-8th grade readability
For an untested recipe, workflowStatus: "idea" is the content registry equivalent of “Needs testing”; keep it there until physical testing is complete
Every recipe must be physically tested at least twice before final approval; this twice-testing requirement is an approved binding internal standard
Record exact ingredient weights, equipment, dimensions or thickness, timings, yield, and failure cases
For poultry, verify a safe internal temperature of 165 degrees F / 74 degrees C
Do not invent testing, author experience, timings, servings, nutrition, quotes, or results
Original food photography is the production standard for recipe publication; record a shot list and write descriptive alt text
Illustrative or AI-assisted imagery is not evidence that a recipe was physically tested
Validate recipe or article schema, nutrition data, units, and visible page content for consistency
Add useful internal links to the hub, supporting articles, and relevant cooking-technique guides
Use authoritative external sources only where safety or factual verification benefits the reader
Include troubleshooting, substitutions, storage, and reheating only when verified and relevant
Avoid arbitrary word-count targets, filler, repetitive FAQs, clickbait, and unsupported superlatives
Create WordPress drafts only when authorized; direct publishing requires explicit approval
Do not expose credentials, tokens, private URLs, or environment values
Complete editorial, SEO, schema, link, image, and mobile-page checks before publication
Publish Pinterest assets only after the corresponding live article has original tested-food photography

authors.name: CookeTricks Editorial
authors.bio: CookeTricks Editorial creates practical recipes and cooking guides for busy home cooks. Content focuses on clear instructions, food safety, useful substitutions, storage guidance, and realistic cooking times. Recipes labeled as tested are prepared and reviewed before publication, while untested drafts remain clearly marked and unpublished.
